reviews.title: Great Budget SSD
reviews.comment: This is a great, cheap SSD. I got it simply for Linux testing,g and it worked perfectly! It took seconds to install anboots inng seconot. It fits nicely in the 2.”” The SATA slot in my pc case is pretty durable, considering I may or may not have accidentally dropped it while installing it. Now, this SSD obviously isn’t anything to write home about, especially at its price point, but for simple stuff, it works great!
reviews.author: Steve K

reviews.title: Impressive Performance, Inexpensive Package
reviews.comment: I needed an external SSD to use for running Linux using a Windows laptop without needing to risk problem with overwriting some critical file or snarling my Windows OS. I installed the drive in an external drive housing (cheap but attractive) that allows drive access and power supply through a USB 3.0 port. It functions quite well, although there is some lag from working through the 3 MB/S interface. It turned out to be a great scheme. It's basically a plug and go solution. Wish I'd done this earlier.
reviews.author: C. Hotchkiss

reviews.title: Oh how I miss you, cheap SSD
reviews.comment: Remember way back when, 6 months ago, when you could buy these SATA3 solid state drives for super cheap? I upgraded some old dells, some laptops, even added them to raspberry pis.... But with the advent of the AI boom and  shenanigans of memory manufacturers, say goodbye to inexpensive SSDs like these. I should have bought some extras.  So far they're working in perfectly.  Faster than an old hard drive or SD card for sure.
reviews.author: Darkraiven!

reviews.title: Buen SSD para uso diario
reviews.comment: Funciona muy bien desde que lo instalé. Es rápido para el uso diario y mejora bastante el rendimiento frente a un disco duro tradicional. Buena opción si buscas algo económico y confiable para tareas básicas.
